name: devops
description: DevOps & engineering-standards toolkit for Claude Code. Bundles skill-git-standard (Git/GitHub: 3-tier branch model, credential gate, PR-only main), skill-docker-standard (containerization: 2-role model, no-credentials-in-image, build-from-main CI/CD to a private registry), and skill-architecture-standard (approved tech stack + UAT/prod topology + decision guide).
